messages: Replicate scatter measured at 1 condition(s): pooled standard deviation 0.0440 mV/K on 1 degree(s) of freedom. This is the measurement uncertainty the surrogate was given, in place of the engine's assumed default. With only 1 degree(s) of freedom this estimate is itself uncertain by roughly a factor of two; treat it as an order of magnitude, and replicate a second condition to sharpen it.
3 sample(s) collapsed onto 2 design point(s); 1 were replicates of a condition already present.

2 design point(s) available (3 sample(s) collapsed onto 2 distinct composition(s)). A surrogate needs at least 3 DISTINCT compositions; measure both pure liquids and the midpoint first, which the campaign needs anyway as mixing-law anchors and drift controls.
